invariants.text: Employee.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Employee.name must be a string
Employee.name must not be null
Employee.email must be a string
Employee.email must not be null
Employee.email must be positive
Employee.age must be an integer
Employee.age must not be null
Employee.age must be positive
Employee.salary must be a number
Employee.salary must not be null
Employee.salary must be positive
The email address of an employee must be valid.
The age of an employee must be between 18 and 70 inclusive.
The salary of an employee must be a positive number.
When creating an employee, if the email is invalid, the operation must fail.
When creating an employee, if the age is less than 18 or greater than 70, the operation must fail.
When creating an employee, if the salary is not positive, the operation must fail.
The sum of all employee salaries must be updated whenever an employee's salary is modified.
Deleting an employee must remove the employee record from the database.
Updating an employee's age must ensure it remains between 18 and 70.
Updating an employee's salary must ensure it remains positive.
